scenarios.preconditions: Isolated sourceScenario() seeded GH/EU synthetic tenants and linked clinical sources

scenarios.expectedPersistence: Authoritative source unchanged by read; audit only; corrections append immutable version

scenarios.expectedRecovery: Reopen/retry reproduces unchanged source evidence; unavailable until integrity/dependency restored
